description: This file defines the Vtiger_MailScannerAction class, which manages email scanning actions such as creating tickets, linking emails to contacts or accounts, and handling email attachments within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailScannerAction
classes.description: Class responsible for executing email scanning actions such as creating tickets, linking emails, and managing attachments in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MailScannerAction object with a specific action ID.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads action details from the database based on the provided action ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Creates or updates the mail scanner action record in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the action record from the database.

methods.name: __nextsequence
methods.description: Retrieves the next sequence number for ordering actions.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Executes the action on a mail record, such as creating or linking emails or tickets.

methods.name: __UpdateTicket
methods.description: Updates an existing ticket based on email content and regex match results.

methods.name: __CreateTicket
methods.description: Creates a new help desk ticket from an email record.

methods.name: __LinkToRecord
methods.description: Links an email to a contact or account record.

methods.name: __CreateNewEmail
methods.description: Creates a new email record in the CRM and links it to a record.

methods.name: __SaveAttachements
methods.description: Saves email attachments to the filesystem and links them to CRM records.

methods.name: __SaveAttachmentFile
methods.description: Stores an attachment file on disk and records its metadata in the database.
